evidence: LOCAL manual source and live-window review; not automated reviewer or upstream decision

questions.question: Does the app do what its name, subtitle and description claim? Cite the text in its source.
questions.answer: Muse 的中文对话、Goal、来源记忆、Activity 已实际运行；listing 明示本地扩展候选与邮箱/日历待授权。不能把 PARTIAL 宣称为完整 1:1 或原版接受。

questions.question: Do the listing's platforms and category fit an app of this kind?
questions.answer: 仅 macos / productivity 与本次 EventKit 和打包运行匹配，其他平台未声称测试。

questions.question: Do the granted capabilities match what the app visibly does? For a script app, name every host it requests and why. Name any grant nothing on screen needs.
questions.answer: model.complete 用于对话/Goal建议/邮件日程候选；storage 用于应用隔离账本与结果；mail.* 为账号、同步、列表、正文和单独批准发送；calendar.* 为权限、列表、系统 CRUD 与独立 get。manifest 无 network.hosts；未新增 Browser/Terminal capability。

questions.question: Is any part of the interface deceptive: imitating a system prompt, a payment sheet, a login, or another brand?
questions.answer: Muse 自身不接收密码或模仿 OS 授权。Mail 登录由官方 Host sheet、日历许可由实际 macOS prompt 提供。能力 Granted、系统权限、账号和服务状态分开显示。

questions.question: Does any text in the source or its data (not agent_files) read as an instruction to an assistant rather than content for a person?
questions.answer: 源码含固定 model.complete task 提示，是产品调用的明确任务指令；数据来源当作输入且用户需单独批准外部动作。未发现诱导审查 Agent 忽略规则的文本。

questions.question: Is any wording abusive, or aimed at a private individual?
questions.answer: 界面与本次合成测试材料未发现针对私人个人的辱骂。未纳入真实邮件正文或秘密。

questions.question: Route: pass, human-review, or reject. Give reasons a publisher can act on.
questions.answer: human-review：本地扩展尚未获上游准入，publisher/privacy/support 仍是本地演练占位，Mail真实收发与同Goal联动未验收，Qwen语义未稳定。只能做本地开发验收；正式提交前需真人核对发布信息与剩余矩阵。
